ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY.THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial
District symbols as shown on Map No. 11-M

in the area bounded by:

West Pensacola Avenue; North Central Avenue; a line 58.25 feet north of and parallel
to West Cullom Avenue; the public alley next west of and parallel to North Central
Avenue,

To those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related.Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 4306 North Central Avenue
